prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a modern streetwear-inspired high-fashion media portrait of a generic adult woman with long silky silver-lavender hair and dark roots, pale blue eyes, natural minimal dewy makeup, light freckles and a neutral direct gaze. She wears a vibrant butter-yellow oversized mesh or jersey top over a high-neck black base layer with approved branding or text only, layered thin gold chains and oversized thin gold hoop earrings. Set her at a public red-carpet or media-event backdrop with bright even studio lighting, a portrait frame from close-up headshot to upper torso, metallic hair sheen, bold primary-color contrast and realistic fabric texture. Do not reproduce Billie Eilish or any other public-figure likeness.
prompt.negative_prompt: explicit, nsfw, overly revealing, celebrity likeness, public-figure likeness, plastic skin, waxy, over-smooth, over-saturated, airbrushed, HDR look, watermark, extra fingers, deformed, invented logos, illegible backdrop text
